source.snippet: Salesforce Data Cloud SFTP ingestion fails with INVALID_COLUMN_NAME errors caused by UTF-8 BOM and Windows-1252 encoding artifacts in CSV first column. Business environment context. Captured 2026-10-15.

problem_statement: Data engineers using Salesforce Data Cloud's SFTP ingestion pipelines frequently encounter ingestion failures caused by invisible encoding artifacts (UTF-8 BOM, Windows-1252 characters) in CSV files, with no automated pre-flight validation or remediation tooling provided by the platform.
target_segment: Salesforce Data Cloud administrators and data engineers at mid-market to enterprise companies running SFTP-based data pipelines
notes: Buyer signal: explicit business environment context. Companies paying for Salesforce Data Cloud (enterprise pricing) are losing engineering time to encoding bugs. A pre-flight CSV sanitizer or SFTP middleware that auto-detects/fixes BOM and encoding issues could be sold as a connector or managed service.
